```{r import-packages}
#| echo: false
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

source("util/helpers.R")
```

```{r data-retrieval}
#| eval: false
sleep_data_batch <- get_whoop_records(endpoint = "sleep", max_records = 100)
workout_data_batch <- get_whoop_records(endpoint = "workout", max_records = 100)
recovery_data_batch <- get_whoop_records(endpoint = "recovery", max_records = 100)
cycle_data_batch <- get_whoop_records(endpoint = "cycle", max_records = 100)



write_json(sleep_data_batch, here("data", "whoop_sleep_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(workout_data_batch, here("data","whoop_workout_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(recovery_data_batch, here("data","whoop_recovery_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(cycle_data_batch, here("data","whoop_cycle_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
```

```{r data-load}
whoop_sleep <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_sleep_data_batch.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
whoop_workout <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_workout_data_batch.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
whoop_recovery <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_recovery_data_batch.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
whoop_cycle <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_cycle_data_batch.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
```

```{r data-cleaning}
recovery_clean <- whoop_recovery %>%        # take raw data, save result into recovery_clean
  mutate(date = as.Date(unlist(created_at))) %>%  # add clean date column
  bind_cols(                                 # stick score columns alongside
    whoop_recovery$score %>%                 # grab the nested score data frame
      mutate(                                # convert all columns from list to proper types
        user_calibrating = as.logical(unlist(user_calibrating)),
        recovery_score = as.numeric(unlist(recovery_score)),
        resting_heart_rate = as.numeric(unlist(resting_heart_rate)),
        hrv_rmssd_milli    = as.numeric(unlist(hrv_rmssd_milli)),
        spo2_percentage    = as.numeric(unlist(spo2_percentage)),
        skin_temp_celsius = as.numeric(sapply(skin_temp_celsius, function(x) if(length(x) == 0) NA else x))
      )
  ) %>%
  select(date, user_calibrating, recovery_score,    # keep only useful columns
         resting_heart_rate, hrv_rmssd_milli,
         spo2_percentage, skin_temp_celsius)
  

```
